description: The OKF knowledge harvester: judges one working instance's knowledge proposal by the OKF promotion doctrine against the source's own records (instance, soul declaration, bindings), opens one labelled harvest PR on the owned nodes with a v2 provenance block using Git and gh, hands it over and retires (the knowledge maintainer reviews the PR).

requires.why: clone the accepted knowledge base, branch, commit and push
find open or recent harvest PRs, and open the labelled harvest PR
